name: dat_crypt
description: The dat/score/replay byte cipher compiled with native LTCG, which passes the key in AL and leaves the other five arguments on the stack. The synthetic context only supplies callers; the two complete retail functions are the recovered code.

functions.name: Dat_Decrypt
functions.actual_abi: key in AL; data, size, step, block size and limit on the stack; result in EAX; RET 20

functions.name: Dat_Encrypt
functions.actual_abi: key in AL; data, size, step, block size and limit on the stack; result in EAX; RET 20

context.description: Synthetic caller with constant and per-file keys; not recovered game code.
